## Football effect

Talib played 58 defensive snaps outside with four tackles, three passes defended and the third-quarter interception of Luck's third-and-long throw for Allen at the Jacksonville 23, returned 1, before the injury was logged at the end of Indianapolis's possession at 8:02 of the fourth quarter; he was removed, and the receipt records Alterraun Verner as the replacement in his slot by the chart's order with no pause recorded, the kernel's replacement under the frozen chart; who filled the slot Verner left is not recorded, and A.J. Bouye's 26 defensive snaps cover the removals of Poyer and Talib together. The hold is the independent medical process's and no football finding attaches to it. On the projection he misses the Monday review on the field and the Wednesday practice of the San Diego week and returns on the Thursday; his availability follows the independent process's communication, not the projection. The Week 4 secondary is Stone's decision after the Monday exams.
